metadata.description: Curated July 2026 sources for LLM engineering: architecture selection, retrieval, adaptation, evaluation, migration, deployment, governance, current-provider verification, post-training algorithms, MoE, distributed training, and test-time compute.
metadata.title: AI Llm - Sources

standards_and_protocols.name: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation

standards_and_protocols.name: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions for GenAI

official_platform_docs.name: Anthropic Prompt Engineering Overview

official_platform_docs.name: Anthropic Test and Evaluate Overview

official_platform_docs.name: Anthropic MCP Guide

official_platform_docs.name: Google Gemini API Documentation
official_platform_docs.relevance: Official Gemini API surface, multimodal capabilities, and platform guidance.

official_platform_docs.name: Gemini Structured Output
official_platform_docs.relevance: Official structured-output and schema guidance for Gemini.

official_platform_docs.name: Gemini Function Calling
official_platform_docs.relevance: Official tool/function-calling guidance for Gemini.

official_platform_docs.name: Gemini Long Context
official_platform_docs.relevance: Official long-context and context-management guidance for Gemini.

official_platform_docs.name: Anthropic Models Overview
official_platform_docs.relevance: Canonical model reference: API IDs, pricing, context windows, and capability flags for all current Claude models including Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, and Haiku 4.5. Sonnet 4.6 and earlier are documented as legacy models on the same page.

official_platform_docs.name: Introducing Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
official_platform_docs.relevance: Launch announcement for Fable 5 (GA, $10/$50 per MTok, 1M context, 128k output, safety-classifier fallback to Opus 4.8 in <5% of sessions) and Mythos 5 (Project Glasswing, research-access only).

official_platform_docs.name: Claude Sonnet 5 announcement
official_platform_docs.relevance: Launch announcement for Claude Sonnet 5 (GA 2026-06-30, `claude-sonnet-5`), positioned as the most agentic Sonnet; list price $3/$15 per MTok with introductory pricing of $2/$10 per MTok through 2026-08-31. Replaces Sonnet 4.6 as the current speed/intelligence-balance tier.

official_platform_docs.name: OpenAI Assistants API Deprecation
official_platform_docs.relevance: Confirms the Assistants API (beta) sunsets 2026-08-26 with no extension; all /v1/assistants, /v1/threads, and related endpoints stop working that day. Required check before any OpenAI migration plan.

official_platform_docs.name: Google Gemini API Models
official_platform_docs.relevance: Canonical Google model list: Gemini 3.1 Pro (large-context reasoning tier, GA 2026-02-19), Gemini 3.5 Flash (GA 2026-05-19), and current deprecation schedule. Verify current IDs, context limits, and pricing before stack selection — do not assume a specific context-window figure without checking this page.

official_platform_docs.name: OpenAI Model Release Notes
official_platform_docs.relevance: Canonical OpenAI model release history, including the GPT-5.6 family (Luna/Terra/Sol tiers, public since 2026-07-09). Verify current flagship and pricing before stack selection.

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: LiteLLM Documentation

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: LlamaIndex Documentation

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: LangGraph Documentation

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: Haystack Documentation
frameworks_and_infrastructure.relevance: RAG, pipelines, and evaluation framework reference.

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: Qdrant Documentation
frameworks_and_infrastructure.relevance: Open-source vector database reference for retrieval systems.

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: Microsoft GraphRAG
frameworks_and_infrastructure.relevance: Graph-based retrieval and knowledge synthesis patterns.

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: PydanticAI Documentation
frameworks_and_infrastructure.relevance: Type-safe agent and structured-output workflows for Python teams.

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: Semantic Kernel
frameworks_and_infrastructure.relevance: Enterprise orchestration framework for .NET, Java, and Python teams.

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
frameworks_and_infrastructure.relevance: Official SDK reference for OpenAI-centric agent workflows.

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: Google Agent Development Kit
frameworks_and_infrastructure.relevance: Official Google ADK reference for agent workflows around Gemini ecosystems.

post_training_and_rl.name: DPO: Direct Preference Optimization
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Foundational reference for DPO — preference optimization without a reward model or rollouts.

post_training_and_rl.name: SimPO: Simple Preference Optimization
post_training_and_rl.relevance: DPO variant without reference model; length-normalized margin reward.

post_training_and_rl.name: KTO: Model Alignment as Prospect Theoretic Optimization
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Preference optimization from binary (scalar) feedback rather than pairwise comparisons.

post_training_and_rl.name: ORPO: Monolithic Preference Optimization without Reference Model
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Single-stage SFT + alignment without reference model.

post_training_and_rl.name: DeepSeekMath (GRPO source)
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Primary reference introducing GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) for RL with verifiable rewards.

post_training_and_rl.name: DeepSeek-R1 Technical Report
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Large-scale RLVR/GRPO application; important for understanding 2025-2026 RL post-training practice.

post_training_and_rl.name: TRL (Transformer Reinforcement Learning) Documentation
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Hugging Face library supporting DPO, KTO, GRPO, ORPO, SFT trainers; verify supported algorithms against current version.

post_training_and_rl.name: OpenRLHF
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Open-source RLHF framework supporting PPO, DPO, GRPO at large scale.

post_training_and_rl.name: GSPO (Group Sequence Policy Optimization)
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Qwen team (Zheng et al., 2025). GRPO-family RL method with sequence-level (not token-level) importance sampling; fixes routing-induced training collapse on MoE models. Production standard for large-scale MoE RL; used to train Qwen3. Verify arXiv ID before citing.

evaluation_and_observability.name: lm-evaluation-harness (EleutherAI)
evaluation_and_observability.relevance: De facto open standard for offline benchmark evaluation of language models; covers MMLU, HellaSwag, GSM8K, HumanEval, and hundreds more.

evaluation_and_observability.name: OpenAI Evals
evaluation_and_observability.relevance: Open-source evaluation harness reference and examples.

evaluation_and_observability.name: HELM
evaluation_and_observability.relevance: Broad benchmarking and evaluation framework reference.

evaluation_and_observability.name: Arize Phoenix Documentation
evaluation_and_observability.relevance: LLM observability, tracing, and evaluation platform reference.

evaluation_and_observability.name: Weights & Biases LLMOps
evaluation_and_observability.relevance: Experiment tracking, observability, and LLMOps workflows.

evaluation_and_observability.name: DeepEval Documentation
evaluation_and_observability.relevance: Evaluation and regression framework for LLM applications.

evaluation_and_observability.name: Braintrust Documentation
evaluation_and_observability.relevance: Prompt/eval tracing, dataset, and experiment-management reference.
